id: 635
status: Duplicate
summary: better 'this' type checking
labels: ['Type-Defect', 'Priority-Medium', 'Restrict-AddIssueComment-Nobody']
stars: 0
commentCount: 4
Comment 0 (2012-01-06): /** @constructor */ function F() {} F.prototype.bar = function() { this.baz(); }; F.prototype.baz = function() { }; /** @constructor */ function G() {} G.prototype.bar = F.prototype.bar; We should notice that "F.prototype.bar" and "G.prototype.bar" have different "this" types, and emit a warning.
Comment 1 (2012-11-02): Relatedly, new: types in @return should be checked against what's really returned: Below, constructorFactory returns a constuctor that doesn't match the declared return type, yet no warning ensues: /** * @typedef {{ * foo: function() * }} */ var Type; /** @constructor */ var T0 = function() {}; T0.prototype.foo2 = function() { window.alert('foo'); }; /** * @return {function(new:Type)} */ var constructorFactory = function() { return T0; }; var T = constructorFactory(); var t = new T; t.foo();
Comment 2 (2014-05-01): Issue tracking has been migrated to github. Please make any further comments on this issue through https://github.com/google/closure-compiler/issues
